payload.claim: DESIGN.md's mitigation table entry ("Saffron breaks Saffron... Self-tasks are risk: elevated, put saffron/ in forbidden") is stated as a blanket rule, but in practice (here and in the sibling specs SA-0334/SA-0335/SA-0337) self-tasks only elevate when they happen to touch one of the specific elevate_on globs, and forbidden only excludes the parts of saffron/ outside touches rather than the whole package. SA-0336 is the one of the four sibling specs that actually lands inside elevate_on (via saffron/ledger.py), which is what surfaces the concern above; this is worth noting only as context, not as a defect in this spec — the spec's own forbidden list is in fact about as tight as it can be given its touches.
